implementation: Wire existing per-group representable one-byte widths into non-symmetric histogram launchers; preserve integer addends, borders, dither and split order. Independently selectable two/four-wave exact 8-bit replica schedules are wired to ordinary and mapped-width production histogram launchers.
remaining_gaps: Existing symmetric width grouping remains the incumbent; the new streaming controls cover its reachable exact 8-bit launcher only.
Streaming for the narrower 5/6/7-bit ladder, multi-stat, non-one-byte and ordered pointwise histogram families remains unimplemented.
Wider-than-supported compressed bins remain pending; no lossy packing added.
T21_STREAM4 takes precedence if both stream controls are explicitly selected; independent arms and interactions should select a single stream count.
